about: Reference for the release table-diff gate: PRIVATE pim.figures.tables over the PRIVATE run artifacts, called as notebooks/build_paper_tables_and_figs.ipynb (part 'paper') and build_appendix_tables_and_figs.ipynb (part 'appendix') call it, each in a fresh process. Part 'extra' holds the same calls on run lists the notebooks do not use (appendix list under cartesian, tab:additional_rw, the token model). Frames carry both the old run names ('run') and the release ids ('run_id'); 'shipped' says whether the (run, block) is in the release bundle (rows with shipped=false are blocks the release deletes: out-of-scope categorical / mine_signed blocks; a replicate spread is shipped only if the parent and all three members keep the block). The release deletes every ND arm, so the 'ND ...' columns have no release counterpart, and the __seed0_s421875 members are not shipped, so 'dropped_steps' [421875] becomes []. Drawn tables are captured cell by cell (values, annotations with the replicate +-SD, row labels old and mapped). NaN = blank cell.
